moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio lp-float, written here): Object y = A sin(2 pi t / 3 s), A 6 px (demo 10 px), sine, seamless 3 s loop; a flat shadow ellipse below (scaleY 0.25, 85 % opacity) changes width by 1.5 % per px of lift (+-15 % in the demo) in antiphase (the demo widens it as the object rises; physically it should shrink). Params: amp (6 px) · period (3 s) · shadow (±15 %). The shadow narrows as the object rises (the site's demo widens it; physically it shrinks).
